index 40e14cb..5a1baa5 100644
--- a/stats.py

@@ -17,4 +17,10 @@ def spread(values):
 
 def median(values):
     """Middle value of the readings."""
-    raise NotImplementedError

+    if not values:
+        raise ValueError("no values")
+    mid = len(values) // 2
+    if len(values) % 2:
+        return values[mid]
+    return (values[mid - 1] + values[mid]) / 2
